question: Who among the following is the first Indian paddler who won a medal at the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF)-Asian Table Tennis Union (ATTU) Asia Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manika Batra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manika Batra** is the first Indian paddler who win a **medal **at the** ITTF-ATTU Asia Cup 2022.**
 
• **The International Table Tennis Federation **(ITTF) is the governing body of table tennis worldwide.
 
• **Asian Table Tennis Union** (ATTU) is the governing body of table tennis in Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mouma Das** is a former Indian table tennis player from** Kolkatta.**

 
 
• At the **2018 Commonwealth Games**, Das took home several medals, including a** gold** in the women's team competition.
 
 
 
• **Manti Ghosh** is an **Indian table tennis player** who has won several national level tournaments.
 
• Naina Jaiswal is **not **a known Indian table tennis player.
